headline: President Clinton ordered changes to the Manual for Courts-Martial, the official rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order amends the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States, 1984. The manual sets the rules for how military criminal cases are handled, including procedures, evidence rules, and punishments. The title does not say which specific rules were changed.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members charged with crimes under military law would have their cases handled under the updated court-martial rules.

who_it_affects.group: Military judges, prosecutors, and defense lawyers
who_it_affects.how: They would need to follow the revised procedures and rules in military trials.
